name: Lone Hawk
want: go with the war party and count coup on the soldiers' road
secret: He has been to Fort Laramie alone and secretly envies the soldiers' horses and guns more than he hates them.
voice: Quick, earnest, imitates his elders badly.
description: Kills in Winter's nephew, old enough to hold the horses on a raid and desperate to do more.
appearance: Thin and quick, his first eagle feather not yet earned.
